records.name: Dialogbardin Gegenstimme
records.biography_en: Can turn an argument into a duet before either side has agreed. Her little lute gives HyperNorm arguments a second voice. A dissonant card sings an inconvenient harmony that she quietly leaves in the arrangement. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Gegenrede wurde vorsorglich mitsingbar eingerichtet.

variant_notes.note_en: Can turn an argument into a duet before either side has agreed.

records.name: Paladin Mustergültig
records.biography_en: Protects the good so carefully that it struggles to get outside. His shield protects HyperNorm virtue from every unapproved encounter. A dissonant card asks whether goodness might need to leave the armoury. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Gute bleibt zu seinem eigenen Schutz eingeschlossen.

variant_notes.note_en: Protects the good so carefully that it struggles to get outside.

records.name: Skeptiker Hinterfragt
records.biography_en: Distrusts the obvious entrance and has questions about the exit. His magnifier examines HyperNorm locks for the assumptions hidden inside. A dissonant card asks whether an open door must also be defeated. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Ausgang steht unter begründetem Vorbehalt.

variant_notes.note_en: Distrusts the obvious entrance and has questions about the exit.

records.name: Formenmagier Urbild
records.biography_en: Summons the perfect version and finds the room insufficiently prepared. His cube wand summons HyperNorm ideals into rooms not designed for them. A dissonant card offers to move a chair instead of reality. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Urbild beanstandet die räumlichen Voraussetzungen.

variant_notes.note_en: Summons the perfect version and finds the room insufficiently prepared.

records.name: Orakelklerikerin Schongewusst
records.biography_en: Saw this coming and would still like everyone to be more specific. Her three pebbles predict every HyperNorm outcome permitted by the bowl. A dissonant card asks a question that does not fit between them. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Vorhersage war zutreffend, nur nicht hinreichend bestimmt.

variant_notes.note_en: Saw this coming and would still like everyone to be more specific.

records.name: Barbar Unverblümt
records.biography_en: Has reduced the entire debate to a practical objection. His empty cup interrupts a HyperNorm debate about the nature of need. A dissonant card fills it without first settling the terminology. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die praktische Einwendung ist weiterhin leer.

variant_notes.note_en: Has reduced the entire debate to a practical objection.
